evidence: bare_number_card: seg3:start, mid and end show two teal circles, each just printed "127%" and labelled "Billionaire wealth". The S&P 500's 195% never appears, so the comparison the narration describes is never shown.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start, mid and end show two identical circles, both "127%" and both labelled "Billionaire wealth". The narration says the S&P 500 grew 195%, but that number and label never appear. Both circles grow to the same size, so nothing is being compared, and the same broken pair stays on screen through seg4.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine got the billionaire-wealth series bound to both sides. The S&P 500 value (195%) and its label never reached the second element, so the two sides render identically.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show two different quantities: billionaire wealth +127% next to the S&P 500 +195%, with the S&P side visibly bigger. A good version would have Data pumping or stacking each one so the stock market visibly overtakes the billionaire pile. That makes the 'it's mostly just stocks' point the payoff, with both sides labelled correctly.
